name: deepa-handmade
description: Deepa Handmade - handmade wire kudai & basket e-commerce platform (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @deepa/shared && npm run build --workspace @deepa/api && npm run build --workspace @deepa/web
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env logs -f --tail=100 mongodb
scripts.infra:reset: node -e "console.log('WARNING: infra:reset destroys the MongoDB data volume (docker compose down -v). Data loss is permanent. Run only when you intend to wipe local data.')" && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env down -v
